status: Discharge network revision; complete OFF and restart behavior remains unqualified

resistor_model.conditions: Add independent initial, TCR, 8000 h standard-mode endurance, solder-heat and 1000 h steady damp-heat allowances. A sensitivity envelope under the cited tests, not simultaneous-stress, arbitrary-lifetime or enclosure qualification.

output_capacitor.scope: Selected external output reservoir only. Initial capacitance tolerance is not a bound for all temperatures, aging, board/internal capacitors, ESR or dielectric absorption. Body dimensions exclude leads and bend/insulation clearance.

controller.scope: Falling VIN threshold lower bound is 1.0 - 0.2 = 0.8 V. Startup lockout starts on power application, not during the OFF dwell. Reset pulse duration, intervening supply ramps and backpowered pins still require bounds.

reference_case.scope: Synthetic sensitivity case, NOT an assembly bound. Includes selected output capacitor initial tolerance, illustrative other capacitances and 10 uA external ingress per rail. Assumes converter disabled and all remaining transfer passive, including any LM66100 conduction; neither condition is yet qualified.

remaining_evidence: Total differential capacitance, initial voltage and rebound/absorption across every board, internal rail, control capacitor and parasitic
Complete switch, USB, signal, sense, return and protection-pin ingress, including retained B/C and charged output capacitors
Guaranteed boost shutdown before applying a passive-transfer bound; arbitrary active voltage conversion is excluded
Reset low-pulse duration, power-up ramp, fault-specific recovery and contact-bounce waveforms
Bleeder series resistance and assembled temperature/power derating

storage_audit.scope: Final candidate ownership, including U7; all capacitance bounds are differential and must include voltage, temperature and retained internal charge. No nominal value is substituted for a missing bound.

boost_storage.finding: Resources list dimensions, STEP and drill guide; no circuit/BOM or guaranteed internal stored-charge bounds. True shutdown is not a zero-storage claim.

efuse_storage.sections: 6.7 switching-characteristic conditions; retained-rail OFF states are outside that test
efuse_storage.finding: Switching data assume discharged OUT and a settled source. They do not supply a worst-case dVdt-node discharge resistance for arbitrary retained-rail OFF states.

bleeders.sections: pp. 2, 4, 8-10: standard-mode ratings, part coding and stress-test changes

output_capacitor.sections: Specification: 1000 uF, +/-20%, 10 V, 10 x 16 mm body, 5 mm pitch

controller.sections: pp. 3-4 VIN UVLO/hysteresis and lockout; pp. 12-13 initial turn-on

controller_diode.sections: 6.5, 8.3.1-8.3.2: CE=GND does not establish reverse-current isolation

boost.sections: 5 V output with 4% accuracy; this does not bound transients or USB injection
